blocked.name: Flamewar, Brash Veteran // Flamewar, Streetwise Operative
blocked.why: "Put all exiled cards you own with intel counters on them into your hand": those cards are face down, and look-and-choose in exile can't pick a face-down card by a counter filter.

blocked.name: Arcee, Sharpshooter // Arcee, Acrobatic Coupe
blocked.why: "That many" is how many creatures and Vehicles you control the triggering spell targets, fixed as it's cast; counting at resolution goes wrong if a target leaves first.

blocked.name: Wan Shi Tong, All-Knowing
blocked.why: No batched "one or more cards are put into a library from anywhere" trigger; per its ruling, scry and surveil reordering don't count.

blocked.name: Blaster, Combat DJ // Blaster, Morale Booster
blocked.why: No static grants modular (its enters-with-counters replacement and dies trigger) to other nontoken artifact creatures and Vehicles.

blocked.name: Xenosquirrels
blocked.why: Nothing lets a player, after rolling, pay to raise or lower the result by 1.

blocked.name: Bamboozling Beeble
blocked.why: A one-shot replacement on a target player's next roll this turn, where the effect's controller chooses which die to ignore (Barbarian Class only ignores the lowest).

blocked.name: The Fourteenth Doctor
blocked.why: copyOnEnter can't add "if you do, it gains haste until end of turn" as part of the replacement; a whenYouDo would make it a trigger that can be responded to.
